scope: Full backend regression after persistent worker gained recognition, cleanup, and cloud export handlers
command: python -m pytest backend/tests -q -p no:tmpdir -p no:cacheprovider -p tmp_fixture_plugin --tb=short

environment.pytest_tmp_path: A temporary fixture plugin rooted tmp_path under S2B_DATA_DIR because Windows denied access to pytest's default temp directory.

first_attempts_and_resolution: An initial full run exposed a too-long isolated data path in one manifest export test; moving to a short data root made that test pass.
AutoCAD Core Console exceeded its existing 20-second timeout under full-suite load; the converter test passed when rerun by itself, and it also passed in the final full-suite run.
acceptance_limits: This establishes backend regression only; it does not close Stage 11.
The worker queue is still single-host SQLite; multi-host queue/storage and CUDA execution remain unaccepted.
Native Autodesk GUI acceptance and field calibration criteria in other stages remain open.
